submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole fires on the token that completes a partitive or portion expression: the ' of' after a word naming a part, remainder or boundary of a whole ('the rest of', 'a part of', 'a portion of', 'the remainder of', 'a member of', 'the majority of', 'half of', 'all of', 'each of', 'the end/beginning/start of'), a temporal noun after a distributor ('every day', 'each time', 'first season'), and the bound continuation of those same stems inside a word or a hyphenated compound (rest|er, rest|lessly, all|ay, maintain|er, full-|time, part-|time, All-|Time). It stays near zero on ' of' after an ordinary relational noun or numeral ('the name of', 'the title of', 'the size of', 'the coach of', 'the director of', 'one of', 'most of') and on a non-temporal noun after 'every'/'each' ('every person', 'each room').

adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests ' of' after role noun 'director' in the same surface frame as partitives.
